column event.document text default (event)::text generated
column event.event jsonb not null
column event.id text not null
column event.occurred_at timestamp with time zone not null
column event.payload_bytes integer not null default octet_length(((event -> 'payload'::text))::text) generated
column event.recorded_at timestamp with time zone not null default clock_timestamp()

constraint event.event_check CHECK ((((jsonb_typeof(event) = 'object'::text) AND (event ?& ARRAY['id'::text, 'operationId'::text, 'at'::text, 'category'::text, 'action'::text, 'status'::text, 'actor'::text, 'subject'::text, 'invocation'::text, 'transaction'::text, 'run'::text, 'approval'::text, 'payload'::text]) AND ((event ->> 'id'::text) = id) AND (COALESCE(length((event ->> 'operationId'::text)), 0) > 0) AND (COALESCE(length((event ->> 'action'::text)), 0) > 0) AND ((event ->> 'category'::text) = ANY (ARRAY['write'::text, 'approval'::text, 'identity'::text, 'automation'::text, 'integration'::text])) AND ((event ->> 'status'::text) = ANY (ARRAY['prepared'::text, 'committed'::text, 'pendingApproval'::text, 'refused'::text, 'conflict'::text, 'failed'::text, 'unknown'::text])) AND (jsonb_typeof((event -> 'actor'::text)) = 'object'::text) AND (((event -> 'actor'::text) ->> 'kind'::text) = ANY (ARRAY['member'::text, 'envoy'::text, 'visitor'::text, 'apiKey'::text, 'system'::text])) AND (occurred_at = ((event ->> 'at'::text))::timestamp with time zone)) IS TRUE))
constraint event.event_id_check CHECK ((id <> ''::text))
constraint event.event_occurred_at_check CHECK (isfinite(occurred_at))
constraint event.event_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id)
constraint event.event_recorded_at_check CHECK (isfinite(recorded_at))
index event_action CREATE INDEX  ON bolt_audit.event USING btree (((event ->> 'action'::text)), occurred_at, id)

index event_pending CREATE INDEX  ON bolt_audit.event USING btree (occurred_at, id) WHERE ((event ->> 'status'::text) = 'prepared'::text)
index event_pkey CREATE UNIQUE INDEX  ON bolt_audit.event USING btree (id)
index event_retention CREATE INDEX  ON bolt_audit.event USING btree (recorded_at, id)
index event_run CREATE INDEX  ON bolt_audit.event USING btree (((event ->> 'run'::text)), occurred_at, id)
index event_search CREATE INDEX  ON bolt_audit.event USING gin (document gin_trgm_ops)
index event_status CREATE INDEX  ON bolt_audit.event USING btree (((event ->> 'status'::text)), occurred_at, id)
index event_subject CREATE INDEX  ON bolt_audit.event USING btree ((((event -> 'subject'::text) ->> 'model'::text)), (((event -> 'subject'::text) ->> 'id'::text)), occurred_at, id)
index event_time CREATE INDEX  ON bolt_audit.event USING btree (occurred_at, id)
